title: Vikings WR Jauan Jennings declined 49ers interest because "I love where I'm at"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Vikings WR Jauan Jennings declined 49ers interest because "I love where I'm at"
sources.description: Wide receiver Jauan Jennings has not played a major role in the Vikings offense through the first eight weeks of the season, but he wasn't interested in switching teams when the possibility presented itself last month.
